A [[Gender/Legends|male]] gambler was the owner of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Bowdaar]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Owing a debt to [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the gambler left Bowdaar to him as a pledge, but instead of returning and buying him back, simply abandoned Bowdaar to fight in gladiatorial matches.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unidentified gambler is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bowdaar companion mission.
